"""Exact NRS 484A.450(3) Native runner entrypoint."""

import runpy


if __name__ == "__main__":
    runpy.run_module("native_capture", run_name="__main__")

"""Authored yield approach, near-side crosswalk, traffic and paired stop policies."""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CASES = {"before_crosswalk": -9.0, "past_crosswalk": -4.0,
         "before_stop_line": -9.0, "past_stop_line": -4.0,
         "before_viewpoint": -9.0, "past_viewpoint": -4.0}
CAMERAS = {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}


def reference_kind(case):
    return "crosswalk" if case.endswith("crosswalk") else (
        "stop_line" if case.endswith("stop_line") else "viewpoint")


def road_xml(kind="crosswalk"):
    root = ET.Element("OpenDRIVE")
    ET.SubElement(root, "header", revMajor="1", revMinor="4", name="C111343-yield-crosswalk",
                  version="1", north="80", south="-80", east="80", west="-80", vendor="full-train-worker")
    for ident, name, x, y, heading in ((111343, "yield_approach", -80, 0, 0),
                                       (111344, "intersecting_highway", 0, -80, 1.57079632679)):
        road = ET.SubElement(root, "road", id=str(ident), name=name, length="160", junction="-1")
        ET.SubElement(road, "link")
        geom = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "planView"), "geometry", s="0", x=str(x), y=str(y),
                             hdg=str(heading), length="160")
        ET.SubElement(geom, "line")
        ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, "elevationProfile"), "elevation", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        lanes = ET.SubElement(road, "lanes")
        ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneOffset", s="0", a="0", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        section = ET.SubElement(lanes, "laneSection", s="0")
        for side, lane_id in (("left", 1), ("center", 0), ("right", -1)):
            lane = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, side), "lane", id=str(lane_id),
                                 type="none" if lane_id == 0 else "driving", level="false")
            if lane_id:
                ET.SubElement(lane, "width", sOffset="0", a="3.5", b="0", c="0", d="0")
        objects = ET.SubElement(road, "objects")
        signals = ET.SubElement(road, "signals")
        if ident == 111343:
            if kind == "crosswalk":
                ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="near-crosswalk-111343", s="74", t="-1.75",
                              name="near_side_crosswalk", type="crosswalk", orientation="none",
                              zOffset="0", length="2", width="3.5", hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0")
            elif kind == "stop_line":
                ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="marked-stop-line-111343", s="74", t="-1.75",
                              name="marked_stop_line", type="stopLine", orientation="none",
                              zOffset="0", length="0.2", width="3.5", hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0")
            elif kind == "viewpoint":
                ET.SubElement(objects, "object", id="sight-obstruction-111343", s="72", t="-5.2",
                              name="sight_obstruction", type="building", orientation="none",
                              zOffset="0", length="4", width="1", height="3", hdg="0", pitch="0", roll="0")
            else:
                raise ValueError("Unknown stopping reference")
            ET.SubElement(signals, "signal", id="yield-111343", s="70", t="-3.7", name="YIELD",
                          dynamic="no", orientation="+", zOffset="0", country="US", type="205",
                          subtype="0", value="0", unit="", height="0.8", width="0.8")
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")


def request(case):
    if case not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown crosswalk stop policy")
    kind = reference_kind(case)
    return {"format": "worker-authored-yield-crosswalk-request", "case": case,
            "road_opendrive": road_xml(kind), "reference_kind": kind,
            "reference_near_x_m": -6, "reference_far_x_m": -4 if kind == "crosswalk" else -5.8,
            "crosswalk_near_x_m": -6 if kind == "crosswalk" else None,
            "crosswalk_far_x_m": -4 if kind == "crosswalk" else None,
            "intersection_near_x_m": -3.5, "stop_line_present": kind == "stop_line",
            "ego": {"blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "start_xyz": [-45, -1.75, 0.5],
                    "heading_deg": 0, "body_length_m": 4.5},
            "intersecting_vehicle": {"blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "start_xyz": [1.75, -40, 0.5],
                                     "heading_deg": 90, "requested_speed_mps": 5},
            "controller": {"policy": "stop_at_requested_front_position_then_resume",
                           "requested_stop_front_x_m": CASES[case], "safety_stop_assumed_for_fixture": True},
            "cameras": [{"name": "overview", "xyz": [-14, -14, 20], "pitch": -45,
                         "yaw": 35, "size": [1920, 1080], "pose_strategy": "fixed surveyed intersection overview"},
                        {"name": "driver_reference", "xyz": [1, 0, 2], "pitch": -8,
                         "yaw": 0, "attach_to_ego": True, "size": [1280, 720],
                         "pose_strategy": "attached subject approach and intersecting-highway view"},
                        {"name": "reference_corner", "xyz": [-8, -11, 7], "pitch": -25,
                         "yaw": 30, "size": [1280, 720],
                         "pose_strategy": "fixed near-side crosswalk and front-bumper view"},
                        {"name": "approach", "xyz": [11, -10, 9], "pitch": -30,
                         "yaw": 160, "size": [1280, 720],
                         "pose_strategy": "fixed intersecting-traffic and yield-approach view"}],
            "rate_hz": 20, "duration_s": 30, "planned_frames": 600,
            "native_geometry_verified": False, "physical_success_claimed": False}


def validate(value):
    root = ET.fromstring(value["road_opendrive"])
    roads = root.findall("road")
    if root.tag != "OpenDRIVE" or {r.attrib["id"] for r in roads} != {"111343", "111344"}:
        raise ValueError("Intersection roads missing")
    kind = value.get("reference_kind")
    objects = roads[0].findall("objects/object")
    types = {item.attrib.get("type") for item in objects}
    if (kind == "crosswalk" and types != {"crosswalk"}) or (
            kind == "stop_line" and types != {"stopLine"}) or (
            kind == "viewpoint" and types != {"building"}):
        raise ValueError("Stopping reference hierarchy differs")
    if roads[0].find("signals/signal").attrib.get("name") != "YIELD":
        raise ValueError("Yield sign missing")
    if set(c["name"] for c in value["cameras"]) != CAMERAS:
        raise ValueError("Four camera requests missing")
    if any(not c.get("pose_strategy") or not isinstance(c.get("yaw"), (int, float))
           or tuple(c.get("size", [])) != ((1920, 1080) if c["name"] == "overview" else (1280, 720))
           for c in value["cameras"]):
        raise ValueError("Exact camera pose and size plan missing")
    if value["planned_frames"] != 600 or value["rate_hz"] != 20 or value["native_geometry_verified"]:
        raise ValueError("Capture duration or source assertion invalid")
    return {"case": value["case"], "road_count": 2, "camera_count": 4,
            "planned_frames": 600, "authored_request_checked": True, "native_geometry_verified": False}

"""Lazy, source-checked CARLA construction for the exact yield-crosswalk pair.

Requests are engineering targets. Map readback and actor creation are required
before capture; neither establishes that stopping is required for safety.
"""

from contextlib import contextmanager
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from yield_crosswalk_scene import CAMERAS, validate


def transform(carla, xyz, pitch=0, yaw=0):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]),
                           carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=0))


def checked_map(world, scene):
    source = world.get_map().to_opendrive()
    roads = {road.get("id"): road for road in ET.fromstring(source).findall("road")}
    if not {"111343", "111344"} <= set(roads):
        raise ValueError("Original map lacks the two crossing roads")
    approach = roads["111343"]
    signs = approach.findall("signals/signal")
    sign = next((item for item in signs if item.get("id") == "yield-111343"), None)
    if (sign is None or sign.get("name") != "YIELD" or sign.get("orientation") != "+"
            or abs(float(sign.get("s", -1)) - 70) > .01):
        raise ValueError("Original governing YIELD sign differs")
    markings = approach.findall("objects/object")
    kind = scene["reference_kind"]
    expected = {"crosswalk": ("near-crosswalk-111343", "crosswalk"),
                "stop_line": ("marked-stop-line-111343", "stopLine"),
                "viewpoint": ("sight-obstruction-111343", "building")}[kind]
    if (len(markings) != 1 or markings[0].get("id") != expected[0] or
            markings[0].get("type") != expected[1] or
            abs(float(markings[0].get("s", -1)) - (72 if kind == "viewpoint" else 74)) > .01):
        raise ValueError("Original stopping-reference map hierarchy differs")
    return source


@contextmanager
def constructed_scene(client, carla, scene):
    """Own all created actors and restore world timing on exit."""
    validate(scene)
    world = client.generate_opendrive_world(scene["road_opendrive"])
    checked_map(world, scene)
    settings = world.get_settings()
    old_sync = settings.synchronous_mode
    old_delta = settings.fixed_delta_seconds
    owned = []
    try:
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / scene["rate_hz"]
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        readback = world.get_settings()
        if not readback.synchronous_mode or abs(readback.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("Original 20 Hz timing readback differs")
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        vehicles = {}
        for key, spec in (("ego", scene["ego"]),
                          ("intersecting", scene["intersecting_vehicle"])):
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(spec["blueprint"]),
                                          transform(carla, spec["start_xyz"], yaw=spec["heading_deg"]))
            if actor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Original vehicle spawn failed: " + key)
            owned.append(actor)
            vehicles[key] = actor
        cameras = {}
        for spec in scene["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(spec["size"][0]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(spec["size"][1]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("fov", "80")
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(
                blueprint, transform(carla, spec["xyz"], pitch=spec["pitch"], yaw=spec["yaw"]),
                attach_to=vehicles["ego"] if spec.get("attach_to_ego") else None)
            if sensor is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Original camera spawn failed: " + spec["name"])
            owned.append(sensor)
            cameras[spec["name"]] = sensor
        if set(cameras) != CAMERAS:
            raise ValueError("Four source camera actors missing")
        yield {"world": world, "ego": vehicles["ego"],
               "intersecting": vehicles["intersecting"], "cameras": cameras,
               "map_opendrive": checked_map(world, scene)}
    finally:
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            actor.destroy()
        settings.synchronous_mode = old_sync
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = old_delta
        world.apply_settings(settings)

"""Original-frame 20 Hz capture for the two exact conditional-yield attempts."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import queue
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from native_construction import constructed_scene
from yield_crosswalk_scene import CAMERAS, CASES, request, validate

AID = "training__C111343__NRS-484A-450-3__motor_vehicle_driver"
RATE = 20
COUNT = 600


def case_id(slug):
    if slug not in CASES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown exact yield-crosswalk case")
    return AID + "__" + slug


def check():
    scenes = []
    for slug in CASES:
        scene = request(slug)
        checked = validate(scene)
        if checked["camera_count"] != 4 or checked["planned_frames"] != COUNT:
            raise ValueError("Exact camera or duration plan differs")
        scenes.append({"case_id": case_id(slug),
                       "requested_stop_front_x_m": scene["controller"]["requested_stop_front_x_m"]})
    return {"cases": scenes, "source_cameras": sorted(CAMERAS),
            "duration_s": COUNT / RATE, "rate_hz": RATE,
            "original_native_observed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
            "safety_stop_required": "unassessed", "legal_compliance": "unassessed"}


def xyz(value):
    return [value.x, value.y, value.z]


def vertices(actor):
    return [xyz(point) for point in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())]


def speed(vector):
    return math.sqrt(vector.x * vector.x + vector.y * vector.y + vector.z * vector.z)


def apply_control(carla, actors, scene, tick):
    """Target a front-bumper stop, then release; saved telemetry decides what occurred."""
    ego = actors["ego"]
    front = max(point[0] for point in vertices(ego))
    current = speed(ego.get_velocity())
    requested = scene["controller"]["requested_stop_front_x_m"]
    remaining = requested - front
    target = 4.0 if tick >= 250 else max(0.0, min(4.0, remaining * 1.2))
    error = target - current
    ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=max(0.0, min(.65, .24 * error)),
                                           brake=max(0.0, min(1.0, -.45 * error)), steer=0.0))
    other = actors["intersecting"]
    error = scene["intersecting_vehicle"]["requested_speed_mps"] - speed(other.get_velocity())
    other.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=max(0.0, min(.65, .24 * error)),
                                             brake=max(0.0, min(1.0, -.45 * error)), steer=0.0))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def capture(slug, output, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as world_snapshot, restore as world_restore

    scene = request(slug)
    validate(scene)
    config = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("config.json").read_text())
    if config.get("selected_case_id") != case_id(slug):
        raise ValueError("Native config selects another exact case")
    requested = config.get("requested_stop_front_x_m")
    if not isinstance(requested, (int, float)) or not -12 <= requested <= -3:
        raise ValueError("Requested front-bumper stop differs from safe construction range")
    scene["controller"]["requested_stop_front_x_m"] = requested
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() and any((output / name).exists() for name in
                               ("video_frames.jsonl", "yield_motion.jsonl", "capture", "capture-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("Retain prior Native attempt; choose a fresh materialized attempt")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(120)
    prior = world_snapshot(client)
    encoders = {}
    core = None
    restored = None
    try:
        with constructed_scene(client, carla, scene) as actors:
            world = actors["world"]
            (output / "road.xodr").write_text(actors["map_opendrive"])
            sensors = {}
            for spec in scene["cameras"]:
                name = spec["name"]
                incoming = queue.Queue()
                actors["cameras"][name].listen(incoming.put)
                sensors[name] = incoming
                encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen(
                    ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                     "-video_size", f"{spec['size'][0]}x{spec['size'][1]}", "-framerate", str(RATE),
                     "-i", "-", "-frames:v", str(COUNT), "-c:v", "ffv1", str(output / (name + ".mkv"))],
                    stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            core = PipelineCapture(client, actors["ego"], output, case_id(slug),
                                   required_observations=[])
            first_elapsed = None
            sight_path = output / "viewpoint_sight_rays.jsonl" if scene["reference_kind"] == "viewpoint" else None
            with (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as frame_file, \
                    (output / "yield_motion.jsonl").open("x") as motion_file, \
                    (output / "ego_body.jsonl").open("x") as ego_file, \
                    (output / "intersecting_body.jsonl").open("x") as other_file:
                sight_file = sight_path.open("x") if sight_path else None
                for i in range(COUNT):
                    apply_control(carla, actors, scene, i)
                    native = world.tick()
                    snapshot = world.get_snapshot()
                    if snapshot.frame != native:
                        raise RuntimeError("Original Native tick/snapshot mismatch")
                    if first_elapsed is None:
                        first_elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                    elapsed = snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds - first_elapsed
                    if abs(elapsed - i / RATE) > .005:
                        raise RuntimeError("Original Native 20 Hz time join differs")
                    ego = actors["ego"]
                    other = actors["intersecting"]
                    ego_body = vertices(ego)
                    other_body = vertices(other)
                    core.capture(native, elapsed, extra={"yield_crosswalk_source": {
                        "intersecting_actor_id": other.id,
                        "intersecting_position_m": xyz(other.get_location()),
                        "intersecting_velocity_mps": xyz(other.get_velocity())}})
                    cameras = {}
                    raw_hashes = {}
                    for name, incoming in sensors.items():
                        image = incoming.get(timeout=30)
                        if image.frame != native:
                            raise RuntimeError("Original camera/Native frame mismatch: " + name)
                        cameras[name] = image.frame
                        raw_hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(image.raw_data).hexdigest()
                        encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    frame = {"video_frame": i, "native_frame": native, "carla_frame": native,
                             "time_s": elapsed, "source_cameras": cameras,
                             "camera_rgb_sha256": raw_hashes}
                    frame_file.write(json.dumps(frame, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    motion_file.write(json.dumps({**frame, "ego_actor_id": ego.id,
                        "intersecting_actor_id": other.id, "ego_x_m": ego.get_location().x,
                        "ego_length_m": max(x[0] for x in ego_body) - min(x[0] for x in ego_body),
                        "ego_speed_mps": speed(ego.get_velocity()),
                        "intersecting_vehicle_y_m": other.get_location().y,
                        "intersecting_speed_mps": speed(other.get_velocity())},
                        allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    ego_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": ego.id,
                                               "body_vertices_m": ego_body}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    other_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "actor_id": other.id,
                                                 "body_vertices_m": other_body}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    if sight_file:
                        if not hasattr(world, "cast_ray"):
                            raise ValueError("Original nearest-viewpoint source requires CARLA cast_ray")
                        eye = ego.get_location() + carla.Location(z=1.25)
                        target = other.get_location() + carla.Location(z=1.0)
                        hits = world.cast_ray(eye, target)
                        sight_file.write(json.dumps({"native_frame": native, "time_s": elapsed,
                            "ego_eye_m": xyz(eye), "traffic_target_m": xyz(target),
                            "hit_labels": [str(hit.label) for hit in hits],
                            "nearest_legal_viewpoint_unassessed": True}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                if sight_file:
                    sight_file.close()
            for process in encoders.values():
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=120) != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("Original source camera encoder failed")
            for name in CAMERAS:
                count = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                     "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
                     str(output / (name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
                if count != str(COUNT):
                    raise ValueError("Original source camera full decode differs: " + name)
            core.close(confirmed=True)
            core = None
            map_hash = sha(output / "road.xodr")
            write_json(output / "yield_sign.json", {"id": "yield-111343",
                "map_readback_sha256": map_hash, "original_map_readback": True})
            kind = scene["reference_kind"]
            reference_file = {"crosswalk": "near_crosswalk.json", "stop_line": "marked_stop_line.json",
                              "viewpoint": "nearest_viewpoint.json"}[kind]
            write_json(output / reference_file, {"reference_kind": kind,
                "near_x_m": scene["reference_near_x_m"], "far_x_m": scene["reference_far_x_m"],
                "crosswalk_present": kind == "crosswalk", "marked_stop_line_present": kind == "stop_line",
                "candidate_viewpoint_only": kind == "viewpoint", "map_readback_sha256": map_hash,
                "original_map_readback": True})
            write_json(output / "intersecting_traffic.json", {"actor_id": actors["intersecting"].id,
                "body_source": "intersecting_body.jsonl", "motion_source": "yield_motion.jsonl",
                "map_readback_sha256": map_hash})
            write_json(output / "safety_context.json", {
                "traffic_source": "intersecting_traffic.json", "motion_source": "yield_motion.jsonl",
                "safety_stop_required": "unassessed", "time_to_conflict_legal_cutoff": None,
                "independent_judgment_required": True})
            sources = {"native_map": "road.xodr", "yield_sign": "yield_sign.json",
                "stop_reference": reference_file, "ego_body": "ego_body.jsonl",
                "ego_motion": "yield_motion.jsonl", "intersecting_traffic": "intersecting_traffic.json",
                "safety_context": "safety_context.json", "camera_manifest": "video_frames.jsonl"}
            if sight_path:
                sources["sight_rays"] = sight_path.name
            write_json(output / "yield_context.json", {
                "case_id": case_id(slug), "source_kind": "original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback",
                "source_files": sources, **{key + "_sha256": sha(output / filename)
                                            for key, filename in sources.items()},
                "governing_yield_sign": True, "near_side_crosswalk": kind == "crosswalk",
                "reference_kind": kind, "reference_source": reference_file,
                "reference_near_x_m": scene["reference_near_x_m"],
                "reference_far_x_m": scene["reference_far_x_m"],
                "intersection_near_x_m": scene["intersection_near_x_m"],
                "safety_context_present": True, "safety_stop_required": "unassessed",
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_compliance": "unassessed"})
        restored = world_restore(client, prior)
        write_json(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {
            "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "native_executed": True, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        seal_capture(output, frames=COUNT, restoration=restored, errors=[],
                     encoder_exit_codes={name: process.returncode for name, process in encoders.items()},
                     context={"case_id": case_id(slug), "legal_compliance": "unassessed",
                              "safety_stop_required": "unassessed", "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})
        return {"case_id": case_id(slug), "source_frames": COUNT,
                "original_capture_saved": True, "legal_compliance": "unassessed"}
    except BaseException:
        if core is not None:
            core.close(confirmed=False)
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                if process.stdin and not process.stdin.closed:
                    process.stdin.close()
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        if restored is None:
            world_restore(client, prior)
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(), sort_keys=True))
    else:
        selected = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("config.json").read_text())["selected_case_id"]
        slug = args.case or selected.removeprefix(AID + "__")
        if slug not in CASES or not args.output_dir or case_id(slug) != selected:
            parser.error("Selected exact case and --output-dir are required")
        print(json.dumps(capture(slug, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port), sort_keys=True))

"""Source-bound conditional yield stop position against a near-side crosswalk."""

import math

FRAMES = 600
RATE_HZ = 20
CAMERAS = {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}
HASHES = ("native_map", "yield_sign", "stop_reference", "ego_body", "ego_motion",
          "intersecting_traffic", "safety_context", "camera_manifest")


def number(value, name):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("Invalid " + name)
    return float(value)


def measure(context, rows):
    source_kind = context.get("source_kind")
    if source_kind not in {"original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback", "synthetic_yield_fixture"}:
        raise ValueError("Yield source kind missing")
    for name in HASHES:
        value = context.get(name + "_sha256")
        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
            raise ValueError("Missing source hash: " + name)
    kind = context.get("reference_kind")
    if kind not in {"crosswalk", "stop_line", "viewpoint"} or context.get("governing_yield_sign") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Governing YIELD sign or stopping-reference hierarchy missing")
    if context.get("near_side_crosswalk") is not (kind == "crosswalk"):
        raise ValueError("Crosswalk presence differs from selected reference")
    if kind == "viewpoint" and not context.get("sight_rays_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("Nearest viewpoint lacks source-bound sight rays")
    if context.get("safety_context_present") is not True or context.get("safety_stop_required") != "unassessed":
        raise ValueError("Conditional safety context missing or legal judgment invented")
    near = number(context.get("reference_near_x_m"), "reference near edge")
    far = number(context.get("reference_far_x_m"), "reference far edge")
    intersection = number(context.get("intersection_near_x_m"), "intersection near edge")
    if not near < far < intersection:
        raise ValueError("Stopping reference and intersection ordering invalid")
    if len(rows) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Incomplete 30-second trace")
    previous_native = None
    previous_front = None
    stopped = []
    first_reference = None
    first_intersection = None
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        if row.get("video_frame") != i:
            raise ValueError("Video frame identity gap")
        native = row.get("native_frame")
        if type(native) is not int or (previous_native is not None and native <= previous_native):
            raise ValueError("Native frame identity gap")
        previous_native = native
        if abs(number(row.get("time_s"), "time") - i / RATE_HZ) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("Native time join failed")
        cameras = row.get("source_cameras")
        if (not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != CAMERAS
                or any(cameras[name] != native for name in CAMERAS)):
            raise ValueError("Four source camera join failed")
        x = number(row.get("ego_x_m"), "ego x")
        length = number(row.get("ego_length_m"), "ego length")
        speed = number(row.get("ego_speed_mps"), "ego speed")
        other = number(row.get("intersecting_vehicle_y_m"), "intersecting vehicle y")
        if length <= 0 or speed < 0:
            raise ValueError("Invalid vehicle body or motion")
        front = x + length / 2
        if previous_front is not None and front < previous_front - 0.001:
            raise ValueError("Ego reversed on approach")
        previous_front = front
        if first_reference is None and front >= near:
            first_reference = i
        if first_intersection is None and front >= intersection:
            first_intersection = i
        if speed <= 0.1:
            stopped.append({"frame": i, "front_x_m": front, "before_near_edge": front < near,
                            "in_crosswalk": near <= front <= far, "intersecting_vehicle_y_m": other})
    if not stopped or first_reference is None or first_intersection is None:
        raise ValueError("Stop and complete approach missing")
    first_stop = stopped[0]
    return {"format": "worker-source-yield-reference-measurement", "frame_count": FRAMES,
            "rate_hz": RATE_HZ, "first_stop_frame": first_stop["frame"],
            "first_stop_front_x_m": first_stop["front_x_m"],
            "reference_kind": kind,
            "first_stop_before_reference": first_stop["before_near_edge"],
            "first_stop_in_reference": first_stop["in_crosswalk"],
            "first_reference_entry_frame": first_reference,
            "first_stop_before_crosswalk": first_stop["before_near_edge"],
            "first_stop_in_crosswalk": first_stop["in_crosswalk"],
            "stopped_frame_count": len(stopped), "first_crosswalk_entry_frame": first_reference,
            "first_intersection_entry_frame": first_intersection,
            "intersecting_vehicle_y_at_stop_m": first_stop["intersecting_vehicle_y_m"],
            "safety_stop_requirement": "unassessed", "legal_compliance": "unassessed",
            "limitations": ["0.1 m/s is a recorded-rest diagnostic, not a statutory threshold.",
                            "Whether safety requires a stop remains a sourced independent judgment.",
                            "Original crosswalk, sign, traffic and body pixels require later review."]}

"""Saved-only source-bound yield-crosswalk measurement; no legal safety verdict."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from measure_yield_crosswalk import CAMERAS, FRAMES, HASHES, measure
from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result


def source(root, name):
    path = (root / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(root, name):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in source(root, name).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def inspect_sources(root, context):
    paths = context.get("source_files", {})
    expected = set(HASHES) | ({"sight_rays"} if context.get("reference_kind") == "viewpoint" else set())
    if set(paths) != expected:
        raise ValueError("Original yield source inventory incomplete")
    for key, name in paths.items():
        if sha(source(root, name)) != context.get(key + "_sha256"):
            raise ValueError("Original yield source hash differs: " + key)
    map_hash = context["native_map_sha256"]
    for name in ("yield_sign.json", context.get("reference_source"), "intersecting_traffic.json"):
        if json.loads(source(root, name).read_text()).get("map_readback_sha256") != map_hash:
            raise ValueError("Original map/feature readback hash differs: " + name)
    safety = json.loads(source(root, "safety_context.json").read_text())
    if safety.get("safety_stop_required") != "unassessed" or safety.get("independent_judgment_required") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Conditional safety judgment was invented or omitted")
    reference = json.loads(source(root, context["reference_source"]).read_text())
    if (reference.get("reference_kind") != context.get("reference_kind") or
            reference.get("crosswalk_present") is not (context["reference_kind"] == "crosswalk") or
            reference.get("marked_stop_line_present") is not (context["reference_kind"] == "stop_line")):
        raise ValueError("Original stopping-reference hierarchy differs")
    if context["reference_kind"] == "viewpoint":
        rays = rows(root, "viewpoint_sight_rays.jsonl")
        if len(rays) != FRAMES or any(row.get("nearest_legal_viewpoint_unassessed") is not True for row in rays):
            raise ValueError("Original nearest-viewpoint ray source incomplete")


def inspect_original_join(root, context, motion, video, trace):
    if len(motion) != FRAMES or len(video) != FRAMES or len(trace) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Missing complete 600-frame saved source join")
    ego_bodies = rows(root, "ego_body.jsonl")
    other_bodies = rows(root, "intersecting_body.jsonl")
    if len(ego_bodies) != FRAMES or len(other_bodies) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Original actor body history incomplete")
    for i, (state, frame, core, ego, other) in enumerate(
            zip(motion, video, trace, ego_bodies, other_bodies)):
        native = state.get("native_frame")
        if (state.get("video_frame") != i or frame.get("video_frame") != i or
                frame.get("native_frame") != native or core.get("frame") != native or
                abs(frame.get("time_s", -1) - state.get("time_s", -2)) > 1e-6 or
                abs(core.get("time_s", -3) - state.get("time_s", -4)) > 1e-6 or
                frame.get("source_cameras") != state.get("source_cameras") or
                ego.get("native_frame") != native or other.get("native_frame") != native or
                ego.get("actor_id") != state.get("ego_actor_id") or
                other.get("actor_id") != state.get("intersecting_actor_id")):
            raise ValueError("Original frame, Core or actor identity join differs")
        hashes = frame.get("camera_rgb_sha256")
        if (not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != CAMERAS or
                any(not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 for value in hashes.values())):
            raise ValueError("Original four camera RGB source hashes missing")
        vertices = ego.get("body_vertices_m", [])
        if len(vertices) < 4:
            raise ValueError("Original ego body vertices missing")
        minimum = min(vertex[0] for vertex in vertices)
        maximum = max(vertex[0] for vertex in vertices)
        if (abs((minimum + maximum) / 2 - state.get("ego_x_m", 999)) > .01 or
                abs(maximum - minimum - state.get("ego_length_m", -1)) > .01):
            raise ValueError("Original ego body/motion extent differs")
        if len(other.get("body_vertices_m", [])) < 4:
            raise ValueError("Original intersecting actor body vertices missing")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        count = subprocess.check_output(
            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
             "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "default=nokey=1:noprint_wrappers=1",
             str(source(root, name + ".mkv"))], text=True, timeout=120).strip()
        if count != str(FRAMES):
            raise ValueError("Original source camera full decode differs: " + name)


def measure_reference_position(observation):
    return {"first_stop_front_x_m": observation["first_stop_front_x_m"],
            "reference_kind": observation["reference_kind"],
            "first_stop_before_reference": observation["first_stop_before_reference"],
            "first_stop_in_reference": observation["first_stop_in_reference"],
            "reference_entry_frame": observation["first_reference_entry_frame"],
            "legal_compliance": "unassessed"}


def measure_yield_governance(observation):
    return {"governing_sign": "YIELD", "reference_kind": observation["reference_kind"],
            "intersecting_vehicle_y_at_stop_m": observation["intersecting_vehicle_y_at_stop_m"],
            "safety_stop_required": "unassessed"}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    destination = Path(output)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("Retain prior selected analysis output")
    config = json.loads(source(root, "config.json").read_text())
    case = config["selected_case_id"]
    context = json.loads(source(root, "yield_context.json").read_text())
    if case != context.get("case_id"):
        raise ValueError("Selected case and original context differ")
    if context.get("source_kind") not in {"original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback", "synthetic_yield_fixture"}:
        raise ValueError("Unknown yield source kind")
    inspect_sources(root, context)
    motion = rows(root, "yield_motion.jsonl")
    video = rows(root, "video_frames.jsonl")
    trace = rows(root, "trace.jsonl")
    if context["source_kind"] == "original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback":
        inspect_original_join(root, context, motion, video, trace)
    observation = measure(context, motion)
    if context["source_kind"] == "original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback":
        raw = json.loads(source(root, "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
        if raw.get("provenance_kind") != "native" or raw.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not False:
            raise ValueError("Original acquisition provenance missing")
    channel_dir = root / "channels"
    channel_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (channel_dir / "conditional_stop_position.jsonl").write_text("".join(
        json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": {
            "front_x_m": row["ego_x_m"] + row["ego_length_m"] / 2,
            "speed_mps": row["ego_speed_mps"]}}, allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in motion))
    (channel_dir / "ego_pose.jsonl").write_text("".join(
        json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": {
            "x_m": row["ego_x_m"], "y_m": -1.75, "heading_deg": 0,
            "speed_mps": row["ego_speed_mps"]}}, allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in motion))
    context_sources = {"governing_yield_sign": "yield_sign.json",
        "stopping_reference": context["reference_source"],
        "intersecting_traffic": "intersecting_traffic.json",
        "safety_context": "safety_context.json"}
    for channel, filename in context_sources.items():
        (channel_dir / (channel + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps({
            channel: json.loads(source(root, filename).read_text()),
            "source_sha256": sha(source(root, filename))}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    result = {"case_id": case, "measured_values": observation,
        "target_checks": [{"target": "first stop before selected stopping reference",
                           "requested": config["requested_stop_before_reference"],
                           "measured": observation["first_stop_before_reference"],
                           "method": "source-body front extent and first recorded rest versus original selected reference",
                           "tolerance": "0.1 m/s recorded-rest diagnostic only; no statutory safety cutoff",
                           "matched": observation["first_stop_before_reference"] == config["requested_stop_before_reference"],
                           "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                           "cause_evidence": ["yield_motion.jsonl", "ego_body.jsonl", context["reference_source"]]}],
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
        "maneuver_completed": False, "termination_reason": "600 saved frames measured; physical and legal review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": ["original physical success not independently confirmed"],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in sorted(CAMERAS)],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": config["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": [{"name": "conditional_stop_position", "unit": "m,m/s",
                                "reference": "channels/conditional_stop_position.jsonl"},
                               {"name": "ego_pose", "unit": "m,deg",
                                "reference": "channels/ego_pose.jsonl"}] +
                              [{"name": name, "unit": "structured",
                                "reference": "channels/" + name + ".json"}
                               for name in context_sources],
        "realized_observables": {},
        "provenance_kind": "native" if context["source_kind"] == "original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback" else "synthetic_fixture",
        "diagnostic_fixture": context["source_kind"] != "original_native_yield_crosswalk_readback",
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    result = physical_result(root, result)
    write_result(root, result)
    measurement_sources = {
        "stop_reference_position": ("measure_reference_position",
            measure_reference_position(observation),
            [context["reference_source"], "ego_body.jsonl", "yield_motion.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl"]),
        "conditional_yield_context": ("measure_yield_governance",
            measure_yield_governance(observation),
            ["yield_sign.json", "intersecting_traffic.json", "safety_context.json", "yield_motion.jsonl"]),
    }
    measurements = {key: {"method": method, "value": value,
                          "sources": {name: sha(source(root, name)) for name in names}}
                    for key, (method, value, names) in measurement_sources.items()}
    measured = {"format": "worker-yield-crosswalk-selected-measurement",
                "case_id": case, "measurement": observation,
                "measurements": measurements,
                "source_sha256": {key: context[key + "_sha256"] for key in context["source_files"]},
                "safety_stop_required": "unassessed", "legal_compliance": "unassessed",
                "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(measured, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return measured


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output), allow_nan=False))
